name: Paloma
instructions: Salt half the rim of a highball glass and fill it with ice. Add the tequila and lime juice, top with grapefruit soda and stir gently. Garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

name: Bloody Mary
instructions: Add everything to a shaker with ice and gently roll it back and forth between two tins rather than shaking hard. Pour into an ice-filled highball glass and garnish with a celery stalk and a lemon wedge.

name: Boulevardier
instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice until well chilled. Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube, or into a chilled coupe. Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Paper Plane
instructions: Shake all four ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. No garnish needed.

name: Tommy's Margarita
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice. Garnish with a lime wheel. No salt rim and no orange liqueur: agave syrup does the sweetening.

name: Gold Rush
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube. Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Gin and Tonic
instructions: Fill a highball or balloon glass with ice. Add the gin, top with chilled tonic water and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Eggnog
instructions: Shake the egg, syrup, milk and cream without ice to froth them, then add the bourbon and ice and shake again. Strain into a chilled glass and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

name: Martinez
instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice until well chilled and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Corpse Reviver #2
instructions: Rinse a chilled coupe with the absinthe and discard the excess. Shake the remaining ingredients with ice and strain into the glass. Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Naked & Famous
instructions: Shake all four ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. No garnish needed.

name: Hanky Panky
instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Vieux Carré
instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube. Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: El Presidente
instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Trinidad Sour
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Yes, a full ounce of Angostura is the point: it is the base of the drink.

name: Between the Sheets
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Ward Eight
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a cherry.

name: Toronto
instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with an orange twist.

name: Charlie Chaplin
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Jasmine
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a lemon twist. It tastes surprisingly like grapefruit.

name: Garibaldi
instructions: Pour the Campari into an ice-filled highball glass. Blend or whisk the orange juice until frothy, pour it on top and stir gently. Garnish with an orange wedge.

name: Oaxaca Old Fashioned
instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice and strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube. Garnish with a flamed orange twist.

name: Siesta
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a grapefruit twist.

name: Appletini
instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with a thin apple slice.

name: Bloody Caesar
instructions: Rim a highball glass with celery salt and fill it with ice. Add the vodka, Worcestershire and hot sauce, top with Clamato and stir. Garnish with a celery stalk and a lime wedge.
